clues: This town is the chief town of its province, in the mid vale of the high range. It sits more than two and a half thousand meters up.
High ground makes this town mild by day and cool by night, all year round. It sits near the equator line, yet the cool nights stay.
Quakes have wrecked this town time and time again. The worst, in 1949, all but razed it; the folk built it back in two years.
Folk call this the Land of the Three Juans, for three famed sons born here. One of them wrote the land's own song.
Folk name this the Town of Blooms and Fruit. They call it the Garden of its land as well.
